body: Btw, regarding https://github.com/sass/sass/issues/3171, this feature might even be useful as it means that those private members can be configured but cannot be written later.

I think this should be an error, since it violates the principle that within a module `$-foo` is a strictly local identifier. We should deprecate both passing it and declaring `!default` on a private variable name.

issue.title: Deprecate configuring private variables when loading Sass modules
issue.body:
- Deprecate `!default` in private sass variables
- Deprecate configuration map keys for private variables (e.g. `$-foo`)

https://github.com/sass/sass/issues/4034
